claim: Château de Beaucastel cuttings imported in 1989 spent three years in USDA quarantine
because: Tablas Creek's own history page says the partners bought the land in 1989 and the first cuttings were imported from France in January 1990. After three years of USDA indexing they were available in 1993, and planting of the estate vineyard began in 1994.
fix: Château de Beaucastel cuttings imported in January 1990 (the land was bought in 1989) spent three years in USDA quarantine; the estate vineyard followed from 1994.
